expectedText: What is the assignment? An essay? A short report. First we plan to do research using the library's books. Then we decide what information belongs in the report. Will there be an experiment in a laboratory? Not in the first week. Later, a biology teacher will show us how to observe water plants safely. A chemistry teacher will help another group. I hope the homework is manageable. I work full time, and I want to avoid studying too late every night. The teacher recommends two short study periods a week. The final assessment is a project and a discussion, not a long examination. Good. Do I need a university degree to join?
